1.items_text:
destination: "Hangzhou (杭州), Zhejiang Province, China"  
weather: "Spring (Mar–May): 15–25°C, cherry blossoms, tea harvest season, occasional rain"  
hero_description: "Experience the best of Hangzhou in one day: start your morning at the sacred Lingyin Temple surrounded by ancient stone carvings, spend the afternoon cycling along West Lake's poetic causeways past iconic sights like Broken Bridge and Leifeng Pagoda, and end your evening savoring authentic Hangzhou cuisine at a lakeside restaurant or exploring the vibrant Hefang Street night market."  

items:  
  - name: "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "The most iconic of the 'Ten Scenes of West Lake' — the image printed on the back of China's 1 RMB banknote. Three stone pagodas rise from the water; the interplay of moonlight and reflections is magical."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "1–1.5 hours"  
  - name: "Broken Bridge"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "The legendary meeting place of the White Snake Lady and Xu Xian. Famous for winter snow scenes but photogenic year-round. Located between Beishan Road and Bai Causeway."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "30–40 minutes"  
  - name: "Su Causeway"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "A 2.8km poetic causeway lined with weeping willows and peach blossoms in spring. Ideal for cycling or walking."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "1–2 hours (walking) / 30–40 min (cycling)"  
  - name: "Leifeng Pagoda"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "Famous from the White Snake legend. Take the elevator to the top for panoramic views of the entire West Lake. Sunset here is legendary — golden light spills across the lake."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "1–1.5 hours"  
  - name: "Curved Yard and Lotus Pool"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "A must-visit in summer (June–August) when the lake bursts with blooming lotuses. The red buildings here are often called 'mini-Kyoto' for their aesthetic."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "45–60 minutes"  
  - name: "Lingyin Temple"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "One of China's largest and most important Buddhist temples, founded in 328 AD. Features over 300 ancient stone carvings from the Five Dynasties to Yuan Dynasty."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "2–3 hours"  
  - name: "Autumn Moon Over the Calm Lake"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "On the northern shore, the premier moon-watching spot especially during the Mid-Autumn Festival. Pair the view with Longjing tea at a lakeside teahouse."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "30 minutes"  
  - name: "Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "A serene garden where you can photograph the classic composition of koi fish + Leifeng Pagoda in one frame. The stone bridge offers the best low-angle shots."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "45 minutes"  
  - name: "Longjing Tea Village"  
    image_url: "N/A"  
    short_description: "The 'First Tea Village' — terraced tea gardens surrounded by mountains. Free to enter. Visit the Old Longjing Imperial Tea Garden (¥10, includes tea) to see the Eighteen Imperial Tea Trees and Longjing Spring."  
    estimated_visit_duration: "2–3 hours"

time_slot: "Morning"  
activity: "Visit Lingyin Temple"  
location: "Lingyin Temple (灵隐寺)"  
tips: "Arrive before 9 AM to avoid crowds. Try the vegetarian noodles inside the temple. Don't take photos in temple halls. Pick up the popular 18-seed bracelet (~¥46)."  

time_slot: "Afternoon"  
activity: "Cycle along West Lake's poetic causeways"  
location: "Su Causeway (苏堤春晓)"  
tips: "Rent a shared bike (~¥20/hour). Cycle from north to south for scenic views."
